Go slow, let the path turn for you."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Nightingale floors squeak like gossip. The gardens are the real throne room."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Silver pavilion, moss garden, and the quiet start the path deserves."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal-side stroll under cherry branches; let the slow ones set the pace."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Wooden stage, big view, and a crowd that thins if you linger near closing."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand carved guardians, all watching you pretend you counted them."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old wooden facades do the storytelling; walk slow and let Gion settle around you."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done with Kyoto patience, and the vegan set is quietly excellent."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Lanterns, narrow lanes, and the river just there; the alley earns its after-dark reputation."}]}
Soft Gion landing, eastern lanes, bamboo and market, golden farewell — every must-do tucked in, shoes off, eyes up.
